item.text: {"text":"{\"status\":\"NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT\",\"core_findings\":[\"Training-pair separation is uneven: negatives outrank positives in 10.38% of Electronics pairs and 8.22% of Industrial pairs, versus 0.14% for Movies and 0.36% for CDs.\",\"Removing the final history item substantially reduces training-prefix hit10 for Movies and CDs; corresponding hit10 intervals include zero for Industrial and Electronics. Embedding alignment scores near 0.5 indicate near-zero mean cosine, without establishing representation rank.\"],\"key_implications\":[\"Movies and CDs show strong sampled training-pair separation and sensitivity to the final history item.\",\"Industrial and Electronics retain more sampled ranking errors; these diagnostics do not establish validation performance or generalization.\"],\"evidence\":{\"headline_metrics\":{\"Electronics:pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate\":0.1038,\"Industrial_and_Scientific:pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate\":0.0822,\"Movies_and_TV:final_removed_hit10_effect\":-0.375,\"CDs_and_Vinyl:final_removed_hit10_effect\":-0.375},\"brief_metric_read\":{\"final_removed_hit10_effect\":\"Paired training-prefix effects; 95% intervals exclude zero for Movies and CDs, conditional on fitted weights and fixed candidates.\",\"embedding_collapse_score\":\"0.5073–0.5212 across categories: little average angular alignment; diversity and representation rank are unmeasured.\",\"macro_four_category_mean\":\"Unavailable; diagnostic results are not the host validation benchmark.\"}}}"}
